test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number from the given options that can replace the question mark (?).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce814adca12e2e53599b8fb6331f585e3ecac661e91e01aee01ab700e65ad37c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/343713a305457ef6c98eb0a9c93ed1c28260abbe8ab01f2afd69603b0815025d.png] 

7 + 6 = 3² + 2²

13 = 9 + 4

13 = 13 (LHS = RHS)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbbf03874898a5e5199d3a40508876ac3eeea578d85678a8ac7dc5e59962093b.png] 

25 + 15 = 22 + 62

40 = 4 + 36

40 = 40 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615f1e3332c8a2386906a2ee5013421bf6683b84f67013f31266e09d2631ef4a.png] 

9 + 20 = 22 + 52

29 = 4 + 25

29 = 29 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5b6fdb1fbda207f61f2bfa6a087bc3b4e38d9d4be816e022f7b48bd8df76b1d.png] 

? + 12 = 32 + 42

? = __**9 + 16**__ - 12

? = __25____** - 12**__

**? = 13**

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
